title: Co-delivery of antigen and adjuvant by site-specific conjugation to dendritic cell-targeted Fab fragments potentiates T cell responses
content:

Peters, Kayleigh Schouren, Felix L. Fennemann, Iris M. Hagemans, Floris J. van Dalen, Johan M. S. van der Schoot, Carl G. Figdor, Aaron Esser-Kahn, Ferenc A. Scheeren, Martijn Verdoes
The aim of therapeutic cancer vaccines is to induce tumor-specific cellular immune responses. In this work, we evaluate molecularly defined DC targeted anti-DEC205 antibody fragment–antigen–adjuvant conjugates (AAA-conjugates) as vaccine platform.
